description: The right-hand plot in Figure 2 is a grouped bar chart titled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)” on its y-axis, which ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 in increments of 0.25. The x-axis displays two model categories: “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini”. For each model, three bars represent different conditions: “Control” (gray), “Before Introspection Training” (light blue), and “After Introspection Training” (dark purple), as indicated by the legend in the top-right corner. Error bars, representing 95% HDIs, are shown atop each bar. For GPT-4o, the Control bar is near 0.15, the Before Training bar is approximately 0.55, and the After Training bar reaches about 0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control bar is near 0.05, the Before Training bar is approximately 0.50, and the After Training bar is around 0.75. The chart visually demonstrates that self-report accuracy improves substantially after introspection training compared to before training, and that both models perform similarly after training, while control models show near-zero correlation.
